description: Check for runtime cost that shows up as dropped frames: DateFormatter and JSONDecoder allocated inside `body`, collections sorted or filtered on every render, ForEach over indices instead of stable identity, non-lazy stacks inside a ScrollView, AsyncImage with no frame, blocking file or network I/O on the render path, and GeometryReader wrapping an entire body. Use when scrolling stutters, launch is slow, or before shipping a list-heavy screen.

path.description: Absolute path to the Swift project root (the folder containing Package.swift or the .xcodeproj).

name: review_swift_performance

score.description: 0-100 defect density. 100 = no findings. penalty = 10*blockers + 3*serious + 1*minor; capacity = files*10. Comparable across runs on ONE project, not between projects.

suggestions.description: Prioritized next actions, deduplicated by rule — not a restatement of every issue's fix.

title: Review SwiftUI and Swift performance
